A 2-cell wall that breathes dead light: a freezing mist 2 cells out from both faces. Enemies in it move 30-55% and attack 20-45% slower (by level; bosses half as much). Needs power; R turns it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Defense |
| Main crystal | Obsidian |
| Build cost | 10 Amber, 30 Obsidian |
| Upgrades give | +HP, +Stronger slow field |

## Levels

The cost on level 1 is the build cost; on later levels it is the cost to upgrade to that level.
